name: webhook
description: Turns an HTTP POST into an event, so an external service (GitHub, a form, a script) can start work.

settings.title: Signing secret
settings.description: Shared secret for the HMAC-SHA256 signature header. Enter env:NAME to read it from Sun's environment instead of storing it.

settings.title: Signature header
settings.description: Header carrying the signature. Accepts a sha256=<hex> prefix, as GitHub sends.

settings.title: Prompt
settings.description: Text sent to the bot. Supports {body}, {event} and {action} placeholders. Leave empty to send the payload as JSON.

settings.title: Accept these event kinds
settings.description: Only forward payloads whose "action" or "event" field is in this list. Leave empty to accept everything.
